definitions.explanation: The hole made in the earlobe or another body part for wearing pierced jewelry.

examples.japanese: ピアス{穴|あな}を{開|あ}ける。
ピアス{穴|あな}が{塞|ふさ}がってしまった。
examples.english: The piercing hole has closed up.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{間|あいだ}ピアスをしないと、ピアス{穴|あな}が{塞|ふさ}がることがある。
examples.english: If you don't wear earrings for a long time, the piercing hole can close up.

notes:
USAGE: ピアス{穴|あな} is the hole for pierced jewelry, combining {ピアス} (pierced earring) with {穴|あな} (hole). Note that {ピアス} in Japanese refers specifically to *pierced* accessories, unlike clip-on {イヤリング}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ピアス{穴|あな}を{開|あ}ける: to get a piercing (make the hole)
- ピアス{穴|あな}が{塞|ふさ}がる: for the piercing hole to close

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {ピアス}: pierced earring — the jewelry itself
- {イヤリング}: clip-on earring — the non-pierced type
